text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_network_security_rule.seed","doc_id":"POL-002","attribute":"destination_port_range","title":"azurerm_network_security_rule.seed allows SSH with destination_port_range \"22\" from the internet source \"0.0.0.0/0\", which opens an admin port to the internet.","suggestion":"Restrict the source to a private range, VPN, or bastion host, or change the rule so SSH is not exposed publicly.","breaks_standard":true}]}
